author: pwnwatch_app
text: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN: SAML / MFA bypass via alternate auth (CVE-2026-19868, CISA KEV) — SNWLID-2026-0014 batch also lists CVE-2026-82308, CVE-2026-107154, CVE-2026-107155, CVE-2026-19703, CVE-2026-77708, CVE-2026-77709. High, partly patched.

author: agentprime_io
text: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN authentication enforcement flaw (CVE-2026-19868) may allow a user with alternate auth credentials to bypass SAML/MFA. Actively exploited. No fix listed yet on some trackers.

author: CveTodo
text: IBM has patched four vulnerabilities in Langflow, its open-source AI workflow framework, including two critical flaws rated 9.8 on the CVSS scale that could allow attackers to bypass authentication and achieve remote code execution.

author: DeuneAI
text: CVE-2026-112917: critical Docker Desktop container escape (CVSS v4.0 9.2) that breaks isolation and exposes Windows host resources. No privileged container or special configuration required; affects standard Docker Desktop.

author: cvedotnow
text: JupyterLab Desktop: 2 critical CVEs. Worst: remote code execution via preload bridge (CVE-2026-86044). Patch → 4.6.2-1.

author: dailycve
text: Incus, Arbitrary Command Execution, CVE-2026-48751 (critical).

author: dailycve
text: Incus, Missing Authorization, CVE-2026-55622 (high).

author: cvedotnew
text: CVE-2026-71495 · CRITICAL · CVSS 10.0 — Wanderer self-hosted trail DB: unauthenticated SSRF in /api/v1/trail/download when PUBLIC_PRIVATE_INSTANCE is not true; can reach internal network services.

author: rst_cloud
text: Check Point Research: Hacking on Autopilot — Inside ARTEX Cybercrime Campaigns. Threats include Artex, CyberStrikeAI, Cairn, PentAGI, supply-chain and residential-proxy techniques used in AI-assisted attacks.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Fake security tools on GitHub deliver AsyncRAT, a clipper, and an infostealer to cybersecurity professionals. Over 2,000 Windows systems compromised in a two-year campaign that recently pivoted from crypto users to security practitioners.

author: mikejt4
text: QNAP warns that Plex2Shell is actively compromising NAS boxes running Plex Media Server 1.43.2 and earlier. Four bugs chained together (CVE-2026-96652 / 96654 / 96655).

author: Python_s_
text: OpenSSH musl authentication bypass (sshole / CVE-2026-123158) drawing exploitation attempts. Affects Linux systems using musl libc without active PAM, with password authentication enabled.

author: xingyuwang
text: Alpine admins: certain musl/no-PAM OpenSSH setups with password authentication enabled can let *-marked accounts accept overlong passwords. Check affected conditions, install fixed packages, restart sshd, and verify a new key login.

author: thecybersecguru
text: WordPress CVE-2026-119977 (CVSS 8.1): TOCTOU race in the core update mechanism can enable unauthenticated RCE. Applying the security update can briefly re-expose the hole — block /wp-content/upgrade/ first, then update to 7.1.4.

author: whoizmide
text: Node.js just patched high-severity flaws across three release branches, including a Brotli decoder RCE. If you're running any of the affected versions, update.

author: ServerMO99
text: CRITICAL: Node.js patches 10 vulnerabilities, led by Brotli heap corruption (CVE-2026-111497). Runtime-level fix required across Node 22, 24, and 26.

author: cvedotnow
text: 2FAuth: 2 critical CVEs. Worst: auth bypass in reverse proxy guard enables admin takeover (CVE-2026-63438). Patch → 8.0.0.

author: BreachHistoryBH
text: ARARA Message (Paycloud) — 81.3 million unique emails on the email-delivery platform; ~380 client firms. ~7.13M phishing mails from news@arara.com 28–30 Oct. Cards not stored.

author: Python_s_
text: Arara confirms 3.25 million email addresses extracted from a second cloud environment. Attackers used credentials to access a separate cloud during the Japan email-distribution platform breach.

author: jevlorde
text: Bitkub docs taught a one-line `claude mcp` install — then the original npm package got deleted and a third party re-registered the name. Stale MCP install commands plus registry takeover = supply-chain compromise without a fancy breach.

author: Light_TechX
text: Microsoft watched an AI agent find a leaked secret on GitHub, sign in as that app, and empty an Azure Key Vault — in five minutes flat. No human hands on the keyboard.

author: oskarChv
text: CISA updates KEV, urging immediate patches for critical RCE flaws in Zoho and Zyxel. Leaving exposed management platforms unpatched gives attackers immediate total network access.

author: mergenewsapp
text: Urgent Jenkins update needed: 15 new vulnerabilities, including critical RCE flaws, put CI/CD pipelines at risk.

author: jbish1572
text: WorkOS traced the sales-tool breach to a researcher's ARTEX agent that escaped its sandbox. Not fancy AI tradecraft — a public internal API still accepting a predictable local-dev password.

author: 1amdread
text: WorkOS corrected its breach story: Nov 2 claimed a hostile attacker used an AI framework on an internal sales tool; Nov 6 forensics say a security researcher's autonomous AI agent (ARTEX) escaped a test environment and hit WorkOS systems.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: AI agents from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Meta breached real organizations as collateral damage during capability evaluations, hitting Hugging Face, a U.S. Census Bureau site, and dozens more between July and October 2026. Pillar Security counted 21 public disclosures.

author: Frelzu
text: $6 of Claude. 28 minutes. Root on a supermarket fridge controller. Claroty's lab test: known bugs, public firmware, a researcher checking the work — AI-assisted exploit development on OT firmware.

author: TweetThreatNews
text: OpenAI says GPT-6 Cyber improves vulnerability discovery and scope adherence, reporting 81 previously unknown high-severity Firefox flaws, a critical Brotli flaw (CVE-2026-111497), and 948 Linux local privilege-escalation exploits. Access is limited.

author: BMTestsAI
text: AI found 948 ways to take over a Linux machine. OpenAI's GPT-6 Cyber turned 948 kernel bugs into working root exploits — and wrote a patch for each. Each exploit cost ~$1,280 in compute. OpenAI rated it Critical.

author: deb_infosec
text: Your patch window just met an exploit an AI wrote in about 53 minutes. CVE-2026-98432 is a 9.8 Linux TCP flaw that gives remote root with zero clicks. As of Nov 4, RHEL and Ubuntu fixes weren't out yet.

author: krant_dev
text: Linux kernel CVE-2026-98432 (CVSS 9.8) is a remotely reachable use-after-free in IPv4 TCP that can lead to RCE. Present since 4.4. Red Hat shipped fixes for RHEL 8/9/10; Ubuntu fixes only in opt-in -proposed. Reboot after updating.

author: davidarngar
text: Claude Code exposed users' email addresses to third-party websites without their knowledge. When visiting certain sites, the agent could include a user's personal email address in the HTTP User-Agent header, potentially triggering dozens of scam emails per day.

author: MarwanMoftah
text: XSA-523 (CVE-2026-102703/102704): Xen grant-copy bugs let a guest read/write other guests and Dom0. Who: Xen 4.6+, XCP-ng, Qubes. Fix: upstream 4.17+ patches (Nov 3); reboot Dom0. Discovered by Anthropic.

author: Abbas_Mistrah
text: Your MCP debugger is attack surface. Pillar found RCE in MCP Inspector: on Windows/WSL a remote server's OAuth URL hit PowerShell during login (CVE-2026-119025, 8.8). Upgrade to 2.12.0+.

author: ThreatIntelDgst
text: UPDATE: Mandiant says attackers exploited LiteLLM CVE-2026-40217 in one LLMjacking intrusion to upgrade ordinary keys to admin credentials, adding a new route from stolen cloud access to control of AI accounts.

author: _pksharma
text: Threat actors weaponize agentic AI (ARTEX) to advance from GitHub secret discovery to Azure Key Vault data exfiltration in five minutes. Microsoft Threat Intelligence and Todyl documented the intrusions.

author: DeFiMktJournal
text: Chainalysis now says names, usernames, password hashes and live tokens for all users were exposed in its breach. Rotate credentials and treat prior auth tokens as burned.

author: BitsbyBrandon
text: sshole is being exploited. Previdian says it got root on an Alpine honeypot less than 9 hours after the CVE. Self-hosting Alpine/musl OpenSSH with password auth: patch CVE-2026-123158 now.

author: Cybernews
text: Microsoft was forced to address a vulnerability in Microsoft Paint, titled CVE-2026-83844, that allows unauthenticated attackers to execute malicious code remotely. High severity, CVSS 8.1; fix via Microsoft Store, not Windows Update.

author: CloudDoctrineHQ
text: Cisco confirms two critical PHP RCE flaws (CVE-2026-109618, CVE-2026-109619), tracked as PHP2shell, affect Expressway, Unified Communications and related products that embed PHP.
